# Fun To Plan: code map

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** A shared family board for 2 to 4 people: chores, events and wish lists, family chat, recurring tasks that take turns, and brownie points for getting things done.
**Live:** https://funtoplan.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/funtoplan · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `.claude/skills/funtoplan/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py funtoplan` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **One server API, unchanged:** every call goes through `ftp.api(action, payload)` / `ftp.run(...)` in
  `client_code/ftp.py` -> `ftp_api(action, payload_json)` (server_code/api.py QUERIES/MUTATIONS). `run` applies the
  reply's `state`, toasts errors and handles the codes `auth` (back to landing), `session` (reload), `nofamily`
  (to #start), `gone` (card deleted). api.py only got `# type: ignore` comments for Anvil's validator.
- **Sync between devices:** `ftp.start_polling()` asks `sync` with the board `version` every 8 s (and when the tab
  becomes visible); a changed board calls `ftp.notify()` -> every `ftp.listen()`er redraws (the open page in
  form_show/hide, the Shell's badges, an open card sheet).
- **Addresses:** `#join=ABC123` (QR codes/old invite links) is parsed in router.show -> `ftp.S["pending_join"]`,
  then landing / start / home. `#board/<filter>` holds the board filter. Signed-in people without a board always
  land on `#start`; the router rewrites the address when it redirects.
- **Dialogs = sheets:** `ftp._sheet(form)` = alert(role="sheet"): bottom sheet on phones (app.css, `:has()`),
  centred card on desktop. The card sheet (Dialogs/Detail) closes with a hand-over: ("edit", id), ("open", id) for a
  FAM-12 link, ("reject", id) -> `ftp.open_detail` loops through them.
- **Still JavaScript:** theme/assets/ftp-fx.js - confetti burst, invite QR (qrcode-generator from cdnjs), camera
  scanner (BarcodeDetector), copy. Everything else is Forms; the old ftp.js/ftp.css are gone.
- **CSS:** app.css = the old fridge-door ftp.css with the same class names (templates use .card, .neu, .pill ...),
  tokens on :root, night = `html.ui-dark` (app-kit.js; old `ftp.theme` light/night values are migrated). Old `.btn*`,
  `.icon-btn`, `.send`, `.tab-add` rules also match Anvil Buttons by role (`.anvil-role-btn-dark > button`). Cards
  use a full-size `.card-open` button under the content so the action button isn't nested inside a button.
- **No admin page:** the JS app had none and the users table has no is_admin column (no schema change).
- Tests: `python tools/check.py`; `python -I tools/ui_test.py --only smoke.js` (signs up, starts a board, walks every
  page, opens a card and adds one). Server tests: tools/testing/test_server.py.
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Data tables (`anvil.yaml` db_schema)

- **families**: name:str, join_code:str, created:dt, version:num, next_seq:num, weekly_goal:num · used in api
- **items**: family→families, seq:num, kind:str, title:str, notes:str, status:str, assignee→members, created_by→members, created:dt, updated:dt, due_date:date, event_at:dt, location:str, link:str, priority:str, points:num, recurrence:str, rotate:bool, requires_approval:bool, series:str, occurrence:num, acks:obj, comment_count:num, points_awarded:num, points_to→members, spawned_next:bool, completed_by→members, completed_at:dt, approved_by→members · used in api
- **members**: family→families, user→users, display_name:str, avatar:str, color:str, role:str, points:num, active:bool, joined:dt · used in api
- **messages**: family→families, author→members, kind:str, text:str, item→items, created:dt · used in api
- **points_log**: family→families, member→members, delta:num, reason:str, item→items, created:dt · used in api
- **users**: email:str, enabled:bool, last_login:dt, password_hash:str, n_password_failures:num, confirmed_email:bool, signed_up:dt, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
